scenarios.planning_vs_implementation: Seed packet explicitly limits scope to planning packets and states that implementation is not included or complete.
scenarios.ready_but_blocked: Packets may be ready-for-agent while an unresolved Blocked by dependency prevents claiming.
scenarios.future_commands: Exact contracts are specified for agent-role, feature-postmortem, and feature-gauntlet interfaces.
scenarios.unsupported_host: Unsupported isolation records needs-independent-roles with an explicit reason and requires external/maintainer binding before completion.
scenarios.role_independence: Reviewer, Hardener, and QA have distinct invocations, identities, manifests, attestations, and frozen Candidate binding.
scenarios.model_routing: Risk and model-floor taxonomy, precedence, escalation, and maintainer-only classification resolution are specified.
scenarios.postmortem_binding: Non-circular Candidate, role-artifact, and postmortem binding sequence is explicit.
scenarios.legal_seed_completion: Seed completion is reserved for maintainer-review preparation and must close through local projection with Closes #53.
scenarios.issue_05_start: Issue 05 may start only after the seed commit is in origin/main and its clean branch merge base equals that revision.
